verdict.rationale: ernd is a corporate card for AI vendor spend, so a conversational policy-enforcement assistant is a fair axis for this kind of product. The evidence pack covers only rewards rates, partner perks, travel points and card signup. It never mentions an AI assistant, receipt chasing, decline explanations or pre-spend policy answers.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an AI assistant enforces policy conversationally — chasing missing receipts, explaining declines, and answering "can I expense this?" before the spend happens
